binding.budgets: unchanged compiler defaults; ResourceLimit is failure

quality_policy.llvm: Full raw LLVM bytes and exact second-line-fingerprint normalization remain observations. Different IR representations are permitted for the reviewed early SSA and proven arithmetic rewrite in this candidate; LLVM textual equality is not an acceptance prerequisite.
quality_policy.machine: Every paired main/candidate successful native request must have identical complete ELF bytes. Different executable bytes stop the run and require independent quality review; no normalized machine-code exception is enabled.
quality_policy.execution: Every successful request in all three arms must match all fixed native input/output/exit oracles. A failed request cannot execute or claim an earlier executable.
quality_policy.units: Each Zil native request requires sixteen actual current object receipts, complete physical objects/symbols, and a physical layout whose exact ownership matches current diagnostic function names. Rust inventories retain actual current sessions; CGU flags alone are not evidence of equal partitions.
quality_policy.authority: IR-change permission is specific to the independently reviewed early SSA/proven rewrite and its real O0/O2 native oracle support. It does not grant permission to accept different final ELF bytes or omit current independent Verify.

limits: Synthetic scalar fixtures, not industrial projects or industrial edit frequencies.
Per-window current main/candidate/Rust only; no cross-window grand speedup.
Two blocks unless the actual manifest states otherwise; no confidence claim.
Resident ZIL response wall versus fresh Cargo/rustc; startup scopes differ.
OS caches are not flushed; outside-timer disk/native scans may warm caches.
Disk is recorded boundary storage, not transient build peak, RSS or SDK size.
Physical bytes include recorded directory/symlink blocks; logical bytes use recorded inode deduplication.
Missing counters are unknown, not zero; nested/parallel timings are not additive wall partitions.
Emission reused_functions are current-request post-O2 body reuses, not incremental function cache hits.
Fallback receipts can include discarded-attempt work; retain fallback flags and ordinary object costs.
5105 capacity observations never enter workflow sums, timing ratios or disk advantage comparisons.
No compiler/native quality gates are rerun by this analyzer; it checks recorded evidence consistency.
